label: gross / after modeled fees, before funding and other unmodeled execution/account effects
claim: One exploratory inspected-Q3 descriptive existing-policy evaluation, not confirmation, independent baseline, causal Spot-versus-futures comparison, live/account realism or advantage

measurement.tailRule: Require i<=N-121 even if an entry could resolve early; full prefix still begins July1
measurement.chronology: One continuous schedule, no block resets; attribute by decision index, retain complete follow-up, report cross-block holdings and follow-up into tail

execution.entry: Next open with original directional validation; risk=abs(stop-nextOpenEntry)
execution.selection: Original higher-score selection, SHORT on tie before eligibility; WAIT has no substitute plan; no first-zone episode substitution; zone reuse allowed
execution.stop: Stop first, adverse gap at open (including equality), no favorable target improvement
execution.target: TP2 exit only; original TP1-touch flag, no partial exit
execution.expiry: Price at i+120 close when loop cursor reaches i+121; next decision i+122
execution.hit: Stop/TP2 break at j; next decision j+1, including hit exactly at i+120 => next i+121
execution.scheduling: WAIT/invalid entry increment by one; one position, preserve original cursor exactly; record exit index and next decision index separately
execution.sameBar: Exit candle touches both stop and TP2; diagnostic only, original stop-first policy retained; no target-first alternative

funding.state: not-applied: calendar completeness and account settlement timing unverified

provenanceOnly.signalAndExecutionSeries: trade only; Mark/funding rows never supplied to engine

statistics: gross and after modeled fees mean/median R
summed positive R and absolute negative R
report.quantiles: Hyndman-Fan type7, h=(n-1)*p, linear interpolation; equal-trade arithmetic mean; no trimming
report.feeLabels: No unqualified net/funding-inclusive return; gross and after modeled fees only
report.missing: Funding is absent/unapplied, never zero; no bound on omitted effects
report.comparisons: No new Spot replay, pooled inference or feed-caused advantage claim

resources.failure: Incomplete runtime only; no partial result publication, truncation, reseed or automatic retry

canonicalization: Recursive sorted JSON, finite numbers only; deterministic raw/summary exclude runtime timestamps
stop: One real run after seal/fixtures, hard3600s; incomplete rather than approximate/retry. Publish/report and stop.
